title: The Year America Had Two Thanksgivings

lines.text: In 1939, America accidentally ended up with two Thanksgivings.
November had five Thursdays that year, so the holiday landed on the very last day of the month.
Store owners panicked. Back then, nobody started Christmas shopping until Thanksgiving was over.
So President Roosevelt simply moved Thanksgiving one week earlier.
The country lost its mind. Calendars were wrong, football games had to be moved, and critics called it Franksgiving.
About half the states followed the president. The rest refused, so some families ate turkey twice.
In 1941, Congress finally settled it. The fourth Thursday of November, forever.
